Olivares AI dev

ENGINE     none found on this machine
SIGNED IN  no
NEXT       olivares quickstart

Start here:
  doctor     Check this host's installation and say what to fix
  login      Sign in to an engine and keep the sign-in for the next commands
  quickstart Start the engine for the first time and open the console
  session    Start, follow, send to, stop and resume agent sessions
  status     Show whether the engine is up and which parts are configured
  tool       Install and sign in the agent tools sessions run (Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, OpenCode, Gemini CLI)
  wiki       Initialize a folder wiki and run its ingest, query or lint skill

All commands: olivares --help
